newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: AGRICULTURAL BANK 5-MO PROFIT 8.271 MLN LITAS.
newsitem.headline: AGRICULTURAL BANK 5-MO PROFIT 8.271 MLN LITAS.

text.p: Lithuania's Agricultural bank said on Wednesday that its revised net profit for the first five months of the year was 8.271 million litas and that its revised May result showed a loss of 3.54 million litas.
The bank said on Friday that its preliminary net profit for the first five months of the year was 8.6 litas and that its losses in May amounted to 3.2 million litas.
The bank's spokeswoman, Imandra Daukshiene, also told Reuters that the assets of the bank inched up to 1.28 billion litas at the end of May compared to 1.27 billion at the beginning of the year.
She said that the loan portfolio of the bank fell to 997.64 million litas at the end of May from 1.08 billion litas at the beginning of 1997.
Deposits if the bank stood at 707.65 million litas, 204.59 million litas of it individual deposits, at the end of May compared to 728.57 million litas at the beginning of the year, Daukshiene said.
The share capital of the bank stands at 128 million litas.
The shareholders decided on Friday to raise the share capital by 42.875 million litas in order to meet the minimum capital adequacy ratio requirements of ten percent set by the central bank.
The capital adequacy ratio of the bank stood at 9.18 percent as of May 1.
The bank also said earlier that the share capital increase will allow it to carry out a more aggressive marketing policy.
The Agricultural Bank is 86 percent state owned and one of the biggest banks in the country in terms of assets.
The bank has been slated for privatisation in the first half of 1998.
The bank reported a net profit of 25.5 million litas for 1996.
